Community Stewardship

Volunteer & Get Involved

Grace Dieu Priory is 100% volunteer-saved and volunteer-run. Whether you can give a few hours a month or just one weekend a year, your contribution keeps the gates open for everyone.

Community Appeal · Belton Maypole Magazine

"A few hours a year keeps the Priory going."

From the urgent volunteer callout published in the Belton Maypole community magazine:

Between 1996 and 2006, our founding committee spent a decade removing dense ivy and consolidating collapsing stonework to open Grace Dieu to the public. In the twenty years since, we have hosted thousands of visitors with zero direct funding from statutory bodies.

The initial group is now aging and struggling to maintain the necessary level of activity. The Priory is financially sound, but unless we can recruit some fresh hands to help with events, trail maintenance, and office tasks, our ability to keep the site open and thriving will be compromised.

Whether you have office skills or a bit of muscle to help erect gazebos, you would be made very welcome in The Friends of Grace Dieu Priory.

Why Join the Friends?
  • Preserve 800 years of English monastic heritage.
  • Enjoy friendly, welcoming community events.
  • Full flexibility: contribute as little or as much as you like.
Opportunities

Where We Need Your Support

Explore our four primary volunteer activity teams. No previous historical experience is required—training and camaraderie provided!

Hands-on Logistics

Event Marshals & Gazebo Setup

Support our major flagship gatherings including the Summer Medieval Fayre and winter Carols in the Cloisters. Help erect heavy-duty gazebos, mark out trader pitches, direct pedestrian flow, and marshal vehicle parking in Rusty Mary’s field.

Time Commitment:2–3 days per year during major events.
Outdoor Green Team

Trail Maintenance & Conservation

Work in the open air keeping footpaths accessible, clearing encroaching brambles, and tidying stone precincts alongside our Charnwood Forest Geopark partners. Help maintain the woodland canopy and discover buried medieval wall fabric.

Time Commitment:Monthly Saturday morning working parties.
Heritage & History

Archival Research & Education

Passionate about local history? Help lead guided walking tours for visiting primary schools, local history societies, and rambling clubs. Assist in transcribing local lore and cataloguing historic relics from the Beaumont era.

Time Commitment:Flexible occasional weekday or weekend tours.
Office & Digital Skills

Committee Governance & Administration

Help ensure the charity stays organized and resilient. We welcome individuals with office skills, secretarial experience, web/social media know-how, grant application writing, and accounting support to assist our Treasurer and trustees.

Time Commitment:A few hours per month from home or at meetings.
Register Interest

Volunteer Intake & Interest Form

Select the areas that match your skills and schedule. Inquiries route directly to David Whitt and our volunteer coordinators.

Your registration will be securely routed to events@gracedieupriory.org.uk.

Thank You for Offering to Help!

Your interest has been logged with our coordinator team. We will be in touch shortly with upcoming working party dates and event plans.

Annual Patronage

Become an Official "Friend of Grace Dieu Priory"

Even if you cannot volunteer physical hours, you can provide vital backing by joining our annual membership. Subscriptions directly finance lime-mortar masonry repairs, footpath drainage, and public educational resources.

Individual
£10 / year

Single adult membership, newsletter, AGM voting.

Popular
Family
£15 / year

Two adults & children at same address.

Life Patron
£100 one-off

Permanent benefactor status for conservation.

To enroll by post, please send a cheque payable to "Grace Dieu Priory Trust" to our Treasurer, Malcolm Allsop (01530 833 632) or submit our volunteer form above.

Visitor Code

Leave No TracePlease take all of your litter home with you. There are no public waste bins on the ancient monument ruins.
Dog WalkersDogs welcome on leads. A dedicated bin is located at the Bull's Head car park for dog litter bags (strictly none on-site).
Strict Site Policy: Paranormal events and ghost walks are expressly forbidden by the Grace Dieu Priory Trust across the entire priory site and surrounding lands.
